CJBG1001683.title: Erasable Highlighters for Annotating Books
CJBG1001683.description: Highlighters that rub out. Mark a line you love, change your mind three chapters later, and erase it without a trace — the reason annotators reach for erasable ink before anything else. Soft colours that don't bleed through ordinary book paper, so the next page stays clean. The pen that turns a paperback into your copy.

CJJT1520893.title: Cherry Blossom Pastel Highlighters
CJJT1520893.description: A set of pastel highlighters in cherry-blossom colours for colour-coding a book as you read: one shade for favourite lines, one for characters, one for the parts that made you cry. Soft tones that sit lightly on the page instead of shouting. A small, pretty gift for the reader who annotates — or wants to start.

CJYD3209849.title: Pearlescent Index Tabs for Books
CJYD3209849.description: Pearl-sheen sticky tabs that mark a page without folding it. Pull one out, stick it on the edge, write a word on it if you like, and find the passage again in a second. Repositionable, so a tab can move as your favourite scene changes. The tidy way to annotate a book you also want to keep beautiful.
